name: Should I install a walk-in shower or keep a bathtub in my guest bathroom?

mainEntity.name: Should I install a walk-in shower or keep a bathtub in my guest bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: The choice depends on how your household and visitors utilize the room. A walk-in shower is popular for older guests, creates a modern aesthetic, and makes smaller guest baths feel larger. However, keeping a bathtub replacement is practical if you have young children or if it is the only bathtub in the house, which can affect resale appeal. A tub-to-shower conversion provides a sleek, low-threshold entry with built-in niches, while a standard tub-shower combination delivers maximum utility for diverse family needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a walk-in shower for modern accessibility and an open feel, but keep a bathtub if it is the only tub in the home or frequently used by young children.
